description:
The process begins when a company identifies the need for a new supplier or vendor.
The procurement team issues a request for proposals (RFP) and receives responses from various suppliers.
Each proposal is evaluated based on criteria like cost, quality, and delivery time.
The team may also conduct site visits or interviews with suppliers.
After careful analysis, a supplier is selected, and contract negotiations begin.
Once both parties agree on the terms, the contract is signed.
The process ends when the supplier is officially onboarded, and the contract is executed.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_SupplierSelection"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/supplier-selection">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RFP" name="Request for proposals"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Proposal" name="Supplier proposal"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_SupplierSelection">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_SupplierSelection"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Suppliers" name="Suppliers"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RFP" name="Issue RFP" sourceRef="Task_IssueRFP" targetRef="Participant_Suppliers" messageRef="Message_RFP"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Proposals" name="Submit proposals" sourceRef="Participant_Suppliers" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProposals" messageRef="Message_Proposal"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_SupplierSelection" name="Select and onboard supplier" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_SupplierSelection" name="Supplier selection begins"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyNeed" name="Identify need for a new supplier"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_IssueRFP" name="Issue RFP" messageRef="Message_RFP"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveProposals" name="Receive supplier proposals" messageRef="Message_Proposal"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateProposals" name="Evaluate proposals">
      <bpmn:documentation>Evaluate each proposal based on cost, quality, and delivery time.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalAssessment" name="Conduct additional assessment?" default="Flow_AssessmentSkipped"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductAssessment" name="Conduct additional supplier assessment">
      <bpmn:documentation>May include site visits or interviews with suppliers.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AssessmentMerge" name="Continue selection"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectSupplier" name="Select supplier"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateTerms" name="Negotiate contract terms"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_TermsAgreed" name="Terms agreed">
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalDefinition_TermsAgreed">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">termsAgreed</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SignContract" name="Sign contract"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_FinalActivitiesSplit" name="Complete onboarding and contract execution"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OnboardSupplier" name="Onboard supplier"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ExecuteContract" name="Execute contract"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_FinalActivitiesJoin" name="Onboarding and contract execution complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SupplierReady" name="Supplier onboarded and contract executed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_IdentifyNeed" sourceRef="Start_SupplierSelection" targetRef="Task_IdentifyNeed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IdentifyNeed_IssueRFP" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyNeed" targetRef="Task_IssueRFP"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IssueRFP_ReceiveProposals" sourceRef="Task_IssueRFP" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProposals"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_Evaluate" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveProposals" targetRef="Task_EvaluateProposals"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Evaluate_AssessmentGateway" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateProposals" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalAssessment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssessmentNeeded" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalAssessment" targetRef="Task_ConductAssessment">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">additionalAssessmentNeeded</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssessmentSkipped" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalAssessment" targetRef="Gateway_AssessmentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assessment_Continue" sourceRef="Task_ConductAssessment" targetRef="Gateway_AssessmentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Select" sourceRef="Gateway_AssessmentMerge" targetRef="Task_SelectSupplier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_Negotiate" sourceRef="Task_SelectSupplier" targetRef="Task_NegotiateTerms"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Negotiate_TermsAgreed" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateTerms" targetRef="Event_TermsAgreed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TermsAgreed_Sign" sourceRef="Event_TermsAgreed" targetRef="Task_SignContract"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sign_Split" sourceRef="Task_SignContract" targetRef="Gateway_FinalActivitiesSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Onboard" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalActivitiesSplit" targetRef="Task_OnboardSupplier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Execute" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalActivitiesSplit" targetRef="Task_ExecuteContract"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Onboard_Join" sourceRef="Task_OnboardSupplier" targetRef="Gateway_FinalActivitiesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Execute_Join" sourceRef="Task_ExecuteContract" targetRef="Gateway_FinalActivitiesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_End" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalActivitiesJoin" targetRef="End_SupplierReady"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
